In December 2025, I underwent a surgery at Rela Hospital, Chrompet, Chennai. The hospital insurance team informed us that they were not tied up with Niva Bupa and shared the contact of a GMoney representative.

The GMoney team offered to settle the hospital bill upfront and handle the reimbursement process on our behalf, giving us a 3-month repayment window. While this sounded helpful initially, the process turned out to be quite stressful.

Additionally, the process required extensive documentation, including bank details and even a video recording of the patient. Managing all this right after surgery, with only my mother assisting me, was extremely difficult and frustrating.

Suggestions for future patients:

- If possible, always opt for cashless insurance, as it is much smoother.
- If reimbursement is the only option, start following up actively from the day of discharge.

- Basic validation checks (like name matching with insurance records) should be done upfront.

- Better coordination is needed to avoid unnecessary loan conversion due to process delays.
